title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Title: Senior Software Engineer
Location : Tampa, FL (Hybrid)
Eligibility Requirements: Must be a US citizen and eligible to obtain a clearance.

Job Summary

The Senior Software Engineer position is in the Global Product Engineering organization assigned to the InSight project. Iron Mountain InSight is a content services platform that provides actionable business insights and predictive analytics through Machine Learning (ML)-based classification of a company’s physical and digital information, which adds structure, context and meta-data to information to make it more usable.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and delivering secure, highly performant microservices and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) within an Agile development lifecycle. To be successful, the candidate needs to have experience with Java and Python core backend application development and SQL databases (SQL Server or Oracle or Postgresql or MySQL).

What You’ll Do
In this role, you will:

- System Design & Architecture : Participate in technical implementation discussions to balance business value, scalability, and delivery timelines using Object-Oriented Programming methodologies and design patterns.

- Backend & Application Programming Interface (API) Engineering : Develop highly performant backend service functionalities and API-to-API integrations using Java (Spring Boot) and Python (Flask) with JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) formats and Structured Query Language (SQL) databases.

- Full-Stack & User Interface (UI) Development : Design and build front-end service layers to support user interface needs using modern web technologies like Angular and React JavaScript.

- Machine Learning & Infrastructure Scalability : Integrate Machine Learning components into microservices and collaborate with infrastructure teams to implement highly scalable, distributed systems.

- Cloud Deployment & Quality Assurance : Utilize Docker containerization to build application images for deployment across Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, and Microsoft Azure, while writing unit tests with a test-driven mindset and debugging performance issues.

What You’ll Bring
The ideal candidate will have:

- 3–5 years of experience in backend application development utilizing Object-Oriented Programming, Java, Python, Docker, Linux shell scripting, and Structured Query Language (SQL) development.

- 3–5 years of experience with cloud service providers like Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, or Microsoft Azure, specifically across storage, compute, and Kubernetes services.

- Strong knowledge of server-oriented architectures, web platform applications, Application Programming Interface (API) gateways, and integration with Representational State Transfer (REST) services.

- Proven ability in developing and deploying scalable Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) microservices, managing architectural governance, conducting security reviews, and identifying performance challenges.

- Solid experience with distributed team environments and Agile Scrum methodologies utilizing tools such as Atlassian JIRA, Rally, Team Foundation Server (TFS), or Version One.

- Mastery of code repositories and version control systems including Git and artifactory repositories.

- Minimum Bachelor’s degree (Bachelor of Science, Master of Science, or Master of Business Administration) combined with strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

What We Offer

- Day-One Benefits: Enjoy comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans with robust benefits starting on your first day of employment.

- Empowering Your Balance: Flexible vacation plan to support your personal and professional well-being.

- Continuous Career Development: Elevate your skills through ongoing training, corporate learning resources, and internal advancement opportunities on a global scale.

- Compensation & Care: Competitive salary commensurate with your experience, paired with a comprehensive company-wide benefits package.

Category: Information Technology

Iron Mountain is seeking an analytical Finance Subject Matter Expert (SME) – ALM Systems, Transformation & Business Intelligence to join our Finance team.

In this role, you’ll play a key part in raising the standard of our global financial architecture during an exciting period of dynamic business growth. By connecting operational workflows to clear financial intelligence, you'll have the opportunity to provide executive leadership with the actionable visibility needed to drive operational efficiency across the enterprise. Here, your expertise will help build the data models and systems integrations that secure a stable foundation for our continued success.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)
In this role, you will:

- Lead Systems Architecture: Map end-to-end billing and settlement workflows while integrating operational, accounting, and inventory management systems to harmonize data models.

- Drive Financial Intelligence: Design and implement frameworks for real-time inventory tracking and asset valuation to provide granular P&L transparency across regions and channels.

- Govern Audit, Risk, and Compliance: Perform structured diagnostic reviews of regional invoicing systems to ensure robust revenue recognition and establish secure approval frameworks.

- Optimize Cash Flow: Streamline and optimize the timeline from initial asset receipt to final cash collection.

- Translate Business Needs: Act as a vital link between executive leadership and technical teams to convert complex financial requirements into practical operational solutions.

What You’ll Bring (Skills & Qualifications) The ideal candidate will have:

- 10+ years of experience in Finance or Finance Transformation , specifically within the Information Technology Asset Disposition (ITAD) or Asset Lifecycle Management industry.

- Strong knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERPs) systems (such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, SAP, or Oracle) and Salesforce Customer Relationship Management tools.

- Proven ability in managing financial integrations following Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) , including navigating complex multi-entity environments and designing data models for margin analysis.

- Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence executive leadership and bridge the gap between technical and operational teams.

What We Offer (Benefits)

- 18-month Fixed Term contract.

- Remote location (Must be based in Colombia or Mexico).

- Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with experience.

- Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

Ready to shape the financial architecture behind our global transformation? Apply today to unlock your potential and take your career to the next level with Iron Mountain.

Iron Mountain is seeking a commercially-driven and detail-oriented Senior Deal Modeler & Pricing Analyst to join our Digital Business Unit (DBU) Americas team.

In this role, you’ll play a key part in translating technical architecture into competitive pricing structures that drive our digital transformation efforts forward. You will have the opportunity to independently build financial models and margin analyses , ensuring our custom digital solutions are priced efficiently and sustainably. Here, your expertise will help evaluate complex deal economics and shape the strategic direction of our rapidly growing digital service offerings.

What You’ll Do
In this role, you will:

- Build Deal-Level Pricing Models: Translate technical solution inputs and operational estimates into accurate financial models and line-item margin analyses.

- Prepare Executive Presentations: Craft clear pricing summaries, sensitivity charts, and presentation decks to outline deal economics and recommend structures for leadership review.

- Perform Scenario Modeling: Conduct financial sensitivity analyses, break-even calculations, and triage incoming deal requests against intake criteria.

- Apply Cost Benchmarks: Utilize established Cost Master metrics for labor, equipment, and facility overhead to ensure custom deal builds and Change Requests are priced effectively.

- Analyze Performance Metrics: Monitor discounting trends, concession logs, and operational throughput to identify systemic opportunities for margin and price growth.

What You’ll Bring
The ideal candidate will have:

- 5+ years of experience in Strategic Pricing, or Deal Desk within digital services, B2B, tech and complex multinational matrix environments.

- Strong knowledge of SaaS business environments and ​advanced Sheets financial modeling and evaluating complex technical solution scopes or capital investments.

- Proven ability to translate intricate data into clear, actionable insights using professional presentation tools (e.g., G Suite / Slides) for non-finance stakeholders.

- Demonstrated capability to independently lead deal modeling for multi-variable opportunities with minimal supervisory oversight.

- A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics and fluent in English and Spanish. Portuguese is a plus. (please submit your cv in English).

What We Offer

- Working from Home Model (based in Colombia or Mexico)

- Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with experience.

- Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth in a global environment.
